testSuite: Microsoft Entra ID Zero Trust & Identity-as-Code Engine
environment: Microsoft Entra ID (P2) Cloud Tenant & CI/CD Pipeline

resultsSummary.calculationMethodology: Sum of all automated verification checks across 7 test suites: Schema validation (11), Snapshot integrity (9), Policy drift engine (5), Deployment failure & rollback recovery (6), Lifecycle engine (9), Governance pre-flight (3), and Native Pester matrix (13).

testSuites.details: All 11 baseline policy definitions validate cleanly against Draft-07 JSON Schema (conditional-access.schema.json) with strict type checking, regex patterns, and required property constraints.

9 security test assertions: Valid sealed snapshot, modified policy payload, tampered manifest, tampered checksums, unlisted extraneous file injection, missing file, duplicate policy ID, corrupt JSON, and path traversal rejection.
5 drift detection tests: Identity equivalence (in-sync), state drift, grant control drift, condition application drift, and new policy creation planning.

testSuites.suiteName: Deployment Partial Failure & In-Flight Atomic Rollback
testSuites.details: 6 transaction assertions: 5-policy batch deployment, simulated Graph API 400 failure on policy 4, fail-closed transaction halting, automated rollback execution, post-rollback live state reconciliation, and audit receipt generation.

testSuites.suiteName: JML Identity Lifecycle State Machine Engine
testSuites.details: 9 unit tests: 24-character cryptographic password entropy, department-to-RBAC mappings, emergency break-glass account protection safeguard, and AST parser syntax checks across all lifecycle scripts.

testSuites.suiteName: Governance & PIM Pre-Flight Syntax & Parameter Engine
testSuites.details: 3 pre-flight tests verifying AST syntax and parameter definitions for access_review.ps1, configure_pim.ps1, and privileged_role_audit.ps1.

13 Pester assertions covering credential entropy, RBAC department routing, break-glass safeguard gates, policy file inventories, schema compliance, report-only default states, break-glass exclusion checks, git hygiene, and secret scanning.
